reuse.why: Every server and shared site that re-implemented the midpoint (preview, post, action sync, forecast, budget template) now calls the existing getScheduledAmount helper.

duplication.why: The diff removes five inline copies of the range rule and leaves a single definition in shared/schedules.ts.

placement.why: The rule change is made in the shared schedules module that already owned getScheduledAmount; callers in server layers only delegate.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the amount rule, its call sites, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Widening the helper's type to accept null/undefined lets all callers drop their own null and number dispatch, so future rule changes touch one function.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, now used by computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, forecast-schedules normalizeSchedule and budget/schedule-template createScheduleList (the template keeps only an op==='isbetween' ternary around it)
